# Project Map

**Last Updated:** 2026-07-13 (auto-generated by /end)
**Project:** plannotator (custom fork of backnotprop/plannotator)

---

## ⚡ Quick Reference (Start Here)

**What:** Plan review UI for Claude Code, OpenCode, Codex, Gemini, and Copilot CLIs. Intercepts `ExitPlanMode` via PermissionRequest hooks; lets users annotate plans, request changes, or approve. Also handles code review for git diffs and annotation of arbitrary markdown/HTML files.

**Tech:** TypeScript + Bun runtime + React (Vite) + Tailwind 4. Monorepo with Bun workspaces.

**Start:** `bun run dev:hook` (plan review) or `bun run dev:review` (code review).

**Top 5 files to know:**
1. `apps/hook/server/index.ts` — CLI entry point; routes args to plan/review/annotate/archive subcommands; reads hook events from stdin and prints `hookSpecificOutput` decisions
2. `packages/server/index.ts` — Bun server shared between Claude Code and OpenCode plugins (plan review server, all `/api/*` endpoints)
3. `packages/editor/App.tsx` — Plan review React app entry; orchestrates Viewer + annotations + multi-LLM auto-review pill
4. `packages/ui/components/AutoReviewCountdown.tsx` — Multi-LLM deliberation pill; countdown → council.py → apply-review → red-team → policy gate → auto-approve
5. `packages/server/review.ts` — Code review server; handles git diff fetching, AI review jobs, agent providers (Claude, Codex, Tour)

---

## Tech Stack

- **Language:** TypeScript (strict)
- **Runtime:** Bun (>=1.3) for compiled binaries; Node for Pi extension
- **Frontend:** React 18, Vite 6, Tailwind CSS 4
- **State:** Zustand-style refs + cookies (per-session, since each hook spawns its own port)
- **Markdown:** marked + DOMPurify (HTML blocks), GitHub alerts, GFM extras
- **Highlighting:** highlight.js bundled
- **Compression:** built-in CompressionStream (deflate-raw) for URL sharing
- **AI providers:** `@plannotator/ai` package — OpenRouter, Anthropic SDK, Codex SDK
- **Build:** Single-file HTML output via vite-plugin-singlefile, then embedded into the compiled Bun binary

- `packages/server/multi-llm-run.ts` — server-owned council.py run manager (buffered event log; enables SSE reconnect with `?since=N`)
- `packages/server/review.ts` — code review server with new `code-nav` peek view and `agent-review-message.ts` shim
- `packages/server/agent-review-message.ts` — upstream PR #675 shim; moved here when `buildCodexReviewUserMessage` was extracted from `codex-review.ts`
- `packages/ui/contexts/AutoReviewContext.tsx` — state machine for multi-LLM deliberation (phases: idle → countdown → deliberating → applying → approval_countdown → done)

**Deployment:**
- `~/.ipe/ipe.bin` (116MB, compiled Bun binary) — the binary Claude Code's PermissionRequest hook executes
- `~/.local/bin/plannotator` — CLI mirror of the same binary
- `~/.ipe/ipe.bin.pre-v0214` — rollback to pre-v0.21.4-merge build

## Recent Session Work (2026-07-13)

- **Plan approval cascades via tmux keypress injection** (`c9149191`) — corrected the root cause of "plan never unlocks after approve": Claude Code 2.1.199–2.1.207 ignore a PermissionRequest `allow` for ExitPlanMode entirely (proven by testing — ignored at 0/1/3/5s, 2.1.199 equally broken, Stop hook can't fire while the dialog blocks the turn). The interactive plan dialog only responds to a keypress. Fix: new `packages/server/plan-dialog.ts` `resolvePlanDialogViaKeypress` injects the approval key via `tmux send-keys` (guarded to the dialog's own option text, digit-only, gated to plain approvals), wired into the claude-code approve path in `apps/hook/server/index.ts` after the mirror handoff. Off-switch `PLANNOTATOR_PLAN_KEYPRESS=0`; trace `PLANNOTATOR_PLAN_KEYPRESS_DEBUG=1`; `hook-decisions.log` gains `keypressInjected`. Verified end-to-end on the real binary + CC 2.1.207 (4/4 trials). Regression test `tests/manual/local/cc-plan-keypress-e2e.sh`; characterization harness `cc-approval-drop-harness.sh`. Supersedes the 2026-07-07 "CC regression / downgrade" decision in DECISIONS.md.

## Recent Session Work (2026-07-05, later)

- **Detached post-approve execution mirror** (`88fc6703`) — the "Live activity" mirror couldn't work in-process: a PermissionRequest hook must emit its decision and `process.exit()` for the agent to implement, killing the server ~1.5s after approve (`ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED` spam, stranded stale plan). On approve the hook now spawns a **detached** (`node:child_process` `detached`+`unref`) `plannotator mirror --handoff <file>` process that outlives it and **rebinds the same port** (retry-until-freed) — the open tab reconnects with zero client changes. New `packages/server/mirror.ts` (`startMirrorServer` + `spawnDetachedMirror`); `subscriberCount()` on `execution-watch.ts` for idle shutdown; `mirror` subcommand in `apps/hook/server/index.ts`. See DECISIONS.md 2026-07-05.
- **Port-in-use detection hardening** (`d90cd892`) — Bun's `Bun.serve` port-collision error message lacks the literal `"EADDRINUSE"` (it says "Is port N in use?"), so every `err.message.includes("EADDRINUSE")` retry guard silently never fired (this is what killed the mirror handoff until fixed). New shared `isAddressInUseError(err)` in `packages/server/remote.ts` (checks code + message), wired into index/review/annotate/goal-setup/mirror; pi's node server fixed inline.
- **Watch-mode graceful flip** (`dc967ddb`) — a review-mode tab whose plan is approved out-of-band fired its multi-LLM review at the mirror → "Review failed · Not available in watch mode". Mirror now tags rejections with `watching:true`; `AutoReviewCountdown` + `App.tsx` treat it as "approved elsewhere" and flip to the watching/Live-activity view instead of erroring. `/api/plan` `watching:true` also mounts a fresh load straight into the watching view (no auto-review).
- **Diagnostic hatch:** `PLANNOTATOR_MIRROR_DEBUG=1` → `~/.plannotator/mirror/mirror-debug.log` (bind attempts, shutdown reason, signals).

## Quick Start Commands

```bash
# Plan-review dev (hot reload)
bun run dev:hook

# Code-review dev
bun run dev:review

# Marketing site dev
bun run dev:marketing

# Full rebuild + reinstall the binary the Claude Code hook actually runs
bun install
bun run --cwd apps/review build       # only when packages/review-editor or packages/ui changed
bun run build:hook                    # builds plan editor HTML, copies review.html
bun build apps/hook/server/index.ts --compile --outfile ~/.ipe/ipe.bin
cp ~/.ipe/ipe.bin ~/.local/bin/plannotator
```

**Critical build invariant:** `build:hook` copies pre-built HTML from `apps/review/dist/`. Any change in `packages/ui/`, `packages/editor/`, or `packages/review-editor/` requires rebuilding `apps/review` first, otherwise the hook ships stale UI bytes.

## Architecture Highlights

- **Two server runtimes, one API surface.** `packages/server/` (Bun, used by Claude Code + OpenCode) and `apps/pi-extension/server/` (Node `http`, used by the Pi extension) mirror each other. Pi tends to drift behind — see auto-memory.
- **The mirror outlives the hook.** The plan-review hook is synchronous (emit decision → exit), so anything that must run *during implementation* — the "Live activity" execution mirror — runs in a **detached** process (`packages/server/mirror.ts`) that rebinds the hook's port after it exits. The council, by contrast, runs *during review* while the hook is alive, so it stays in-process (DECISIONS.md 2026-07-03 vs 2026-07-05).
- **Hook output is the contract.** Stdout from `apps/hook/server/index.ts` is the only payload Claude Code sees on a PermissionRequest. Approve emits `{behavior:"allow", permissionDecisionReason, updatedPermissions}`. Deny emits `{behavior:"deny", message}`. The IPE wrapper post-processes to inject `bypassPermissions` without dropping fields.
- **Cookies, not localStorage.** Each hook invocation runs on a random port, so settings persist via cookies that work across origins.
- **Auto-review pipeline is decoupled.** `b8a7ef5` separated `approval_countdown` from the apply-promise chain to avoid `handleApprove` reading stale markdown after the multi-LLM merge. State lives in `AutoReviewContext`.
- **Multi-LLM runs are server-owned jobs.** `multi-llm-run.ts` buffers council.py events in memory; the UI attaches/reattaches via `?since=N` so dropped SSE connections resume instead of failing. One run at a time; completed run stays replayable until the next start.
- **Upstream merges use the regraft strategy.** See `DECISIONS.md` (2026-07-03) — heavily-rewritten upstream files are taken wholesale, then fork features re-applied; never favor-HEAD.
- **Plan history is automatic.** Every plan saves to `~/.plannotator/history/{project}/{slug}/NNN.md` on arrival, before the UI loads. Powers the version browser and plan-diff badge.
- **HTML output is embedded in the binary.** Single-file HTML produced by Vite is `import`-attribute-loaded by Bun at build time. Means you cannot live-reload the UI against a running binary; you have to rebuild and re-run.

## External Integrations

- **OpenRouter** — multi-LLM deliberation (gemini-lite, GPT-4.1 Mini, DeepSeek, Mistral, llama). Pricing in `AutoReviewCountdown.tsx`
- **Anthropic SDK** — Claude as a code-review agent provider (Fable 5 + Opus 4.8 in dropdowns since 0.21)
- **Codex app-server** — JSON-RPC transport (replaced @openai/codex-sdk in 0.21); discovers models dynamically from the local codex
- **council.py** (sidecar) — orchestrates the multi-LLM deliberation; binary calls it via `Bun.spawn`
- **Jina Reader** — URL→markdown conversion for `plannotator annotate https://...`
- **Obsidian / Bear / Octarine** — note integrations on approve
- **paste service** — `plannotator-paste.plannotator.workers.dev` for short URL share links
